metadata.speaker: Speaker 1
metadata.overall_summary: In a quiet, tired voice, the speaker leaves instructions regarding tasks for the Root Hackathon before taking a nap. Having messaged an organizer and wanting to preserve personal perks while awaiting a response, they ask to utilize the $300 in free Google Cloud Platform (GCP) credits to work on Codex threads. They suggest figuring out how to use multivariant setups or third-party models like Fable at maximum power due to performance bottlenecks, while specifically cautioning not to completely drain the GCP credits before they return.

transcript_segments.text: For the Root Hackathon, I, I mean, messaged someone there. I need to continue a lot of the Codex threads, but I don't want to use any of my free perks.

While waiting for his reply, I want to utilize the free GCP that we got as well. I think it was 300 bucks, and, um, [unclear: that one ships?], basically what I want is to figure out how to use the multivariant,

and then use that to continue the Codex thread because everything is slow over at Breeze. And, um, I'm going to take a nap now, so please finish it. By the time I come back, it should be finished, but please don't drain the GCP credits. [sigh]

Like, I know so far all we've been using it to transcribe, but I'm not sure if Pro is good enough as Codex, or if we use the third-party models, like Fable to finish it, since a lot of these Codex threads aren't finishing up. So also utilize max power of Fable, please.
